cam_push.text: The camera pushes in toward her.

cam_track_l.text: The camera tracks left across the frame.

walk_in.text: She walks forward toward the camera.

papers.text: Loose papers blow across the floor.

walk_in_only.text: She walks forward toward the camera. Nothing else in the frame moves.

smoke.text: Smoke rolls across the frame from the left.

lean_in.text: She leans forward toward the camera.

hand_reach.text: She reaches her right hand forward toward the camera.

leaves.text: Dry leaves blow across the frame.

step_back.text: She steps backward away from the camera.

steam.text: Steam drifts left across the lens.

cam_pull.text: The camera pulls back away from her.

walk_out.text: She walks out of frame to the left.

door.text: The door swings open behind her.

walk_away.text: She walks away from the camera into the depth of the frame.

cup_lift.text: She lifts the cup from the table to her mouth.

hair_lifts.text: Her hair lifts and falls back against her shoulder.

cam_lock.text: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move.
